Interface VirtualControllerManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
ControllerManager
public interface VirtualControllerManager
Granular interface through which network handlers communicate with the server controller layer.

This is the server-side counterpart of VirtualServer: just as VirtualServer exposes granular methods that the client calls on its proxy of the server, this interface exposes granular methods that network handlers (SocketClientHandler, RmiClientHandler) call on ControllerManager.

Each method corresponds to a single client-initiated action and carries an explicit clientId parameter (a UUID string assigned at connection time). Network handlers are responsible for injecting the correct clientId before delegating here; ControllerManager uses it to look up the associated player, lobby, and game.

This abstraction achieves the "collapse upward" principle recommended for mixed Socket/RMI architectures: both transport implementations converge on the same high-level method calls, keeping ControllerManager and GameController unaware of the underlying transport.

  • Method Details

    • handleClientConnected

      String handleClientConnected(VirtualView view)
      Called when a new client establishes a connection. Registers the client's VirtualView and returns the assigned clientId.
      Parameters:
      view - the server-side proxy for sending notifications to this client
      Returns:
      the unique client identifier assigned to this connection

    • handleDisconnection

      void handleDisconnection(String clientId)
      Called when a client's connection is lost or explicitly closed. Handles lobby removal or in-game disconnection as appropriate.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the identifier of the disconnected client

    • requestSetUsername

      void requestSetUsername(String clientId, String username)
      Requests that the given nickname be assigned to the client in their current lobby.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the requesting client
      username - the desired nickname

    • requestCreateLobby

      void requestCreateLobby(String clientId, int numPlayers)
      Requests creation of a new lobby with the specified player capacity.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the requesting client, who becomes the lobby creator
      numPlayers - the total number of players the lobby should wait for (2–5)

    • requestJoinLobby

      void requestJoinLobby(String clientId, String lobbyId)
      Requests that the client join an existing lobby identified by lobbyId.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the requesting client
      lobbyId - the target lobby identifier

    • requestSelectTotem

      void requestSelectTotem(String clientId, Totem totem)
      Requests totem selection for the client within their current lobby.
      Parameters:

      totem - the chosen totem color

    • requestLeaveLobby

      void requestLeaveLobby(String clientId)
      Requests that the client leave their current lobby. The client is returned to the pre-lobby state and notified of available lobbies.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the requesting client

    • requestReconnect

      void requestReconnect(String clientId, VirtualView view, String nickname, String gameId)
      Requests reconnection of a previously disconnected player to an ongoing game. The client must supply the nickname they used in the original session and the game identifier.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the new connection's client identifier
      view - the new VirtualView for sending notifications to this client
      nickname - the nickname of the player attempting to reconnect
      gameId - the identifier of the game to reconnect to

    • requestMoveTotem

      Parameters:

      tileId - the letter identifier of the target offer tile
